name: BETA Climbing
description: BETA — Climbing gym management data access. Provides read-only administrative access to a climbing gym's operational data via the BETA (sendmoregetbeta.com) platform. Supports querying gyms you administer, searching climber/member records, retrieving membership passes and punch cards, listing products for sale, viewing check-in session logs, and reviewing transaction history. Useful for gym administrators who need to look up members, audit check-in activity, track pass usage, or review sales and revenue data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BETA Climbing to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BETA Climbing to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sendmoregetbeta.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BETA Climbing MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BETA Climbing provides these MCP tools: list_climbers, list_gyms, list_passes, list_products, list_sessions, and list_transactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BETA Climbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BETA Climbing in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does BETA Climbing MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BETA Climbing requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BETA Climbing is developed by BETA Climbing. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
